'''Swmilk''' was an establishment in [[Daiyu City]] on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]]. It was advertised by several [[Color|white]] [[Aurebesh]] signs on the building facade, while signage saying "[[milk]]," using the same font as the business name, was used to attract potential customers: A yellow sign was sitting on top of the building, while an orange sign could be seen in the street.<ref name="Kenobi" />
